reviews.subject: Client.native
reviews.review: Reinitializes the inherited set client after each request. Collapsed transport and owned adapter/gateway lifecycle need one explicit owner; review login settlement, Required array, user bytes and audit arrays without inferring unsigned/native equivalence.

reviews.subject: page_entries
reviews.review: Reads legacy HmiResponse ConfigPage and calls QUERY_CONFIG. Move browsing to the published read-only view/RPC while retaining per-value mask/policy and no-change predicates; replace generator-side configuration ordinals/revisions/keys with published identities.

reviews.subject: current
reviews.review: Asserts fixed active/ring slots, state and shelving arrays. Map exact raw/private facts separately from canonical logical extents, retain the standing-event identity, owner session/policy restoration and all cleanup attempts.

reviews.subject: Guarded.guard
reviews.review: The restore method alone is migrated. Guard/login, main preflight/final checks, sink verification and inherited genealogy/text-resource runners still contain legacy reads and require their own accounting before C6 hides legacy exposure.
